reviews.title: Language upgrade
reviews.text:
I was using this app previously, where I could easily select my preferred language and use voice typing. However, after updating my iPhone, these features are no longer available or are difficult to find.

I understand that software updates are intended to improve the user experience, but removing or limiting useful existing features can make the experience more difficult for users.

Would it be more appropriate to consider this as an upgrade only if the existing language-selection and voice-typing features are retained or improved? I hope these features can be restored or made available again in a future update.

reviews.title: Gboard Bug Report
reviews.text:
When opening Gboard, there are strange pre-populated  'word' suggestions. Please see the screenshots attached.

You can see on the example I type 'testing' into Google Chrome, Gboard takes the initial obscure suggestion and concatenates this to 'testing'.

Other 'words' that I have seen appear include 'UTF-8', 'google admin - password', 'gws wiz' and others which appear to be random letter formats similar to passwords, not mine.

This has been ongoing for a few weeks now, I have tried clearing everything on Gboard as well as deleting and reinstalling but to no avail.

Gboard is usable with this bug but it is frustrating from a user experience point of view.

reviews.title: Just another keyboard now
reviews.text:
I use to LOVE Gboard but not anymore!  I use to install Gboard as one the first apps on new phones it was awesome!  

I guess in their drive to get more money and extract more data from users though Google has done away with the best feature of Gboard and the was the very easy and simple voice to text feature!

It was quick and easy to use!  Just hit the microphone speak what you wanted to and you were done!  Now that is gone!  

Now, you hit the microphone, Gboard attempts to open another app which can tax weak phones or even new state of the art phones and then once assistant makes its grab entrance it sits there and with infinity spinner like it is trying to figure out why it was brought out of cold storage for no good reason?  I can’t think of a reason why either except to extract more data from us users!!!  

Then if it does ever stop spinning your try to speak and and it has no clue so out of frustration, you have to shut it down and just type manually!  

Please Google for all that is holy stop sacrificing user experience for more data points to sell to your customers. That is not the way!  You ruined a great product. I’m uninstalling an app that I have used and loved for years and doubt I’ll ever be back!!!

I know you will not see this nor do you care, but a lot of times when you lose someone who has used and loved an app for years, and it is due to fundamental changes that nerf that app and not bugs, but it can be bugs if they aren’t fixed timely then you lose them

reviews.title: It has fallen off a CLIFF
reviews.text: Gboard’s recent decline in performance on iPhone—with growing typos, misspellings, and lag—appears to be caused by a combination of changes in recent iOS updates (especially iOS 18 and iOS 26) and possible abandonment or delays in support for Gboard itself on iOS. Many users have reported similar issues, and slow-motion video evidence shows that the keyboard sometimes registers the wrong character even when the correct key is tapped, indicating a software-level bug rather than user error or hardware problems
